title: Diagnose a trace bug
prompt: This method should return `1 + 2 + ... + n` for n >= 1 (and 0 for n <= 0), but its loop never terminates correctly for some inputs. Trace `sumTo(3)` and `sumTo(-1)` with a state table, find the drift, and fix it.

tests.name: sums correctly
tests.hint: i != n never stops when n < 1: the counter starts ABOVE n and runs away.
